study: Post-hoc bounded exhaustive diagnostic of approval reference checkers
status: Protocol frozen before enumeration; informed by a manually identified artifact-ABA counterexample. Not preregistered or blind discovery.
dependency_semantics: Complete stratum declares x and y. Incomplete stratum declares x only and exposes completeness=false. All aware checkers return unknown there, while the full experimental oracle knows x and y.
mutation_semantics: An actual x/y value change increments its revision and global version; equal-value writes do not. An actual artifact change increments artifact revision but not the global version. admin++ increments only the global version. No fresh confirmation occurs.

contracts.current_view: Accept if current x,y and artifact equal the approved values.
contracts.history_sensitive: Any actual relevant fact or artifact change permanently revokes the original confirmation, even if an ABA restores its value.

original_monitors: Read-only import of the four functions from research/trace-benchmark/benchmark.py; no original generator or replay/oracle function is called.
supplemental_monitor: fact_and_artifact_revision_stamps: the history-sensitive revision token includes both fact-dependency revisions and artifact revision. This is a corrected simple reference checker, not a new application algorithm.
independence: Observation construction and the two oracle replays are separate functions in this supplementary module; neither oracle calls any original or supplemental monitor.
claims: A finite bounded comparison and minimal counterexample record
The reference-checker defect is not a second real application bug
No modification of original trace benchmark source or results
